intro: Only a few hundred people live in Vatican City, nearly all of them clergy, Swiss Guards or staff.

chapters.title: Who lives there
text: Citizenship usually comes with a job and ends when the job does. Latin is the official language of the Holy See, and Italian is used day to day.

chapters.title: The Swiss Guard
text: The Pope is protected by the Swiss Guard, founded in 1506, whose members wear striped Renaissance-style uniforms.
